written.description: Runs a second, independent agent whose only job is to re-exploit what the first one claimed, so a finding is either reproduced or dropped. One self-hosted binary with a local dashboard.

alive.last_commit_message:
fix(llm): surface in-completion gateway errors and log why a completion was empty (#851)

* fix(llm): surface in-completion gateway errors and log why a completion was empty

A chat-completions 200 response with empty content and no tool calls was returned as an empty string, so the agent burned its empty-response budget without any record of the cause. Decode the choice-level error, finish_reason, native_finish_reason, refusal and reasoning presence; return an error when the gateway reports one inside the completion, and log a one-line diagnostic otherwise.

Refs #23

* fix(llm): decode refusal as raw JSON so non-string shapes cannot break parsing
